name: Tetebatu Waterfall Trek
description: Trek through the lush jungle trails of Tetebatu to discover two hidden waterfalls: Jeruk Manis and Ulem Ulem. The route follows a river upstream through tropical forest at the southern foot of Mount Rinjani, with natural swimming pools along the way.
description_id: Jelajahi jalur setapak rimba tropis Tetebatu untuk menemukan dua air terjun tersembunyi: Jeruk Manis dan Ulem Ulem. Rute ini menyusuri hulu sungai melalui hutan alami di lereng selatan Gunung Rinjani, lengkap dengan kolam pemandian alami sepanjang perjalanan.

itinerary.title: Meet at Tetebatu village, briefing and light breakfast
Trek to Jeruk Manis waterfall (approx. 45 min walk)
Swim and explore around Jeruk Manis
Continue upstream to Ulem Ulem waterfall
Lunch at a local warung near the trailhead
Return to Tetebatu village

itinerary_id.title: Kumpul di desa Tetebatu, pengarahan rute dan sarapan ringan
Trek menuju air terjun Jeruk Manis (jalan kaki sekitar 45 menit)
Berenang dan bersantai di sekitar air terjun Jeruk Manis
Melanjutkan perjalanan ke hulu sungai menuju air terjun Ulem Ulem
Makan siang masakan lokal di warung dekat jalur masuk
Kembali ke desa Tetebatu

name: Tetebatu Rice Terrace Walk
description: A gentle morning walk through the rice terraces surrounding Tetebatu village. Your guide explains the Subak irrigation system, points out local crops and medicinal plants, and stops at a tobacco drying barn where farmers prepare their harvest.
description_id: Jalan pagi santai menyusuri pematang terasering sawah hijau di sekeliling desa Tetebatu. Pemandu Anda akan menjelaskan sistem irigasi Subak tradisional, memperkenalkan aneka tanaman obat herbal lokal, dan singgah di lumbung pengeringan tembakau warga.

itinerary.title: Early morning start from Tetebatu (06:30 for best light)
Walk along rice paddy paths with views of Mount Rinjani
Visit a tobacco drying barn and chat with local farmers
Stop at a local coffee garden, try Lombok robusta coffee
Return to starting point

itinerary_id.title: Mulai pagi hari dari Tetebatu (06:30 untuk momen cahaya terbaik)
Menyusuri jalur sawah dengan latar megah Gunung Rinjani
Kunjungan ke lumbung tembakau dan berbincang dengan petani lokal
Singgah di kebun kopi lokal dan mencicipi kopi robusta khas Lombok
Kembali ke titik kumpul awal

includes: Coffee and snack at garden stop
includes_id: Kopi lokal dan camilan tradisional di kebun

name: Monkey Forest & Jungle Walk
description: Walk through the Tetebatu Monkey Forest where wild long-tailed macaques live in their natural habitat among towering tropical trees. The trail continues through dense jungle and emerges at a small waterfall where you can cool off before heading back.
description_id: Menyusuri Hutan Monyet Tetebatu di mana kawanan monyet ekor panjang dan lutung hitam hidup liar di habitat aslinya di bawah pohon-pohon tropis raksasa. Jalur setapak berlanjut menembus rimbunnya hutan dan bermuara di air terjun tersembunyi untuk menyegarkan diri.

itinerary.title: Meet at the Monkey Forest entrance, safety briefing
Walk through the forest, observe macaque troops in their territory
Continue on the jungle trail deeper into the forest
Reach the small hidden waterfall, swim if you like
Walk back via an alternate route through farmland

itinerary_id.title: Bertemu di pintu masuk Hutan Monyet, pengarahan keselamatan
Menyusuri kawasan hutan, mengamati kawanan monyet di alam liar
Melanjutkan trekking lebih dalam ke vegetasi hutan tropis
Tiba di air terjun alami tersembunyi, waktu santai dan berenang
Berjalan kembali lewat rute alternatif melintasi perkebunan warga

name: Loyok Bamboo Craft Village Tour
description: Visit Loyok village, famous across Lombok for its bamboo weaving tradition. Watch artisans hand-weave baskets, bags, and furniture from local bamboo. You can try weaving a small piece yourself under their guidance and take it home as a souvenir.
description_id: Kunjungi desa Loyok yang melegenda di seluruh Lombok berkat tradisi anyaman bambunya. Saksikan ketelitian para pengrajin menganyam keranjang, tas, dan perabot. Anda bisa langsung mencoba menganyam suvenir bambu kecil didampingi pengrajin untuk dibawa pulang.

itinerary.title: Pickup from Tetebatu (or meet at Loyok village)
Introduction to Loyok's bamboo craft history
Visit three artisan workshops, see different weaving techniques
Hands-on: weave your own small bamboo piece with a local artisan
Browse the village craft market
Return to Tetebatu

itinerary_id.title: Penjemputan dari Tetebatu (atau bertemu langsung di desa Loyok)
Pengenalan sejarah panjang tradisi anyaman bambu Loyok
Kunjungan ke tiga workshop warga, melihat variasi teknik anyam
Praktik langsung: menganyam suvenir bambu sendiri dipandu warga
Melihat galeri dan pasar kerajinan desa
Perjalanan kembali ke Tetebatu

includes: Local guide and transport from Tetebatu
includes_id: Pemandu lokal dan transportasi dari Tetebatu
Biaya workshop dan seluruh bahan bambu
Minuman segar dan jajanan pasar lokal

name: Pringgasela Traditional Weaving Experience
description: Pringgasela is the center of traditional Sasak hand-weaving in East Lombok. Women in the village still use backstrap looms passed down through generations to create intricate songket and ikat textiles. Spend a morning learning the process from raw thread to finished cloth.
description_id: Pringgasela adalah pusat mahakarya tenun Sasak di Lombok Timur. Para wanita desa masih setia menenun menggunakan alat tradisional kayu (gedogan) warisan leluhur. Pelajari proses lengkap dari pemintalan benang, peracikan warna alami daun dan akar hutan, hingga sehelai kain jadi.

itinerary.title: Pickup from Tetebatu (or meet at Pringgasela)
Welcome and introduction to Sasak weaving traditions
Watch weavers at work on backstrap looms
Learn about natural dye preparation from local plants
Try weaving on a loom with guidance from a local weaver
Browse textiles and return to Tetebatu

itinerary_id.title: Penjemputan dari Tetebatu (atau bertemu di desa Pringgasela)
Sambutan hangat dan pengenalan filosofi motif tenun Sasak
Menyaksikan penenun bekerja dengan alat tenun gedogan
Melihat proses pengolahan pewarna alami dari tumbuhan lokal
Mencoba menenun sehelai kain dengan bimbingan penenun desa
Melihat koleksi kain tenun dan kembali ke Tetebatu

includes: Local guide and transport from Tetebatu
includes_id: Pemandu lokal dan transportasi dari Tetebatu
Demonstrasi tenun dan sesi praktik interaktif

name: Tetebatu Full Day: Culture & Nature
name_id: Tetebatu Sehari Penuh: Alam & Budaya Sasak
description: The complete Tetebatu experience in one day. Start with a sunrise rice terrace walk, visit the Monkey Forest, trek to Jeruk Manis waterfall, then drive to Loyok or Pringgasela for a craft village visit in the afternoon. Covers all the highlights of the Tetebatu area.
description_id: Pengalaman terlengkap Tetebatu dalam satu hari. Dimulai dengan jalan pagi saat matahari terbit di pematang sawah, menyusuri Hutan Monyet, trekking ke air terjun Jeruk Manis, dilanjutkan dengan kunjungan budaya ke desa anyaman bambu Loyok atau tenun Pringgasela pada siang harinya.

itinerary.title: Early morning rice terrace walk (06:30 start)
Walk through the Monkey Forest
Trek to Jeruk Manis waterfall, swim and rest
Lunch at a local warung in Tetebatu
Drive to Loyok bamboo village or Pringgasela weaving village (your choice)
Workshop visit and craft browsing
Return to Tetebatu by late afternoon

itinerary_id.title: Trek sawah berkabut pagi hari (mulai pukul 06:30)
Menyusuri Hutan Monyet dan rimba tropis
Trek ke air terjun Jeruk Manis, berenang dan istirahat
Makan siang masakan khas di warung lokal Tetebatu
Berkendara ke desa bambu Loyok atau desa tenun Pringgasela
Workshop kerajinan tangan dan interaksi dengan pengrajin
Kembali ke Tetebatu menjelang sore hari

includes: Local guide for the full day
